question: What is the first step in the customer support ticket process?
options: A. Ticket Classification Engine
B. Customer Support Ticket Received
C. Knowledge Base Lookup
D. Escalation Manager

question: If a ticket is classified as low priority, and no article is found in the knowledge base, what is the next step?
options: A. Send Relevant Article to Customer
B. Route to Tier 1 Support
C. Assign Escalation to Tier 2 Support
D. Create Escalation Task

question: Starting from 'Customer Support Ticket Received', which of the following is a possible sequence of nodes?
options: A. Ticket Classification Engine -> Escalation Manager -> Create Escalation Task -> Route to Tier 1 Support
B. Ticket Classification Engine -> Knowledge Base Lookup -> Send Relevant Article to Customer -> Close Ticket - Resolved
C. Ticket Classification Engine -> Escalation Manager -> Create Escalation Task -> Assign Escalation to Tier 2 Support -> Tier 2 Support Notified
D. Ticket Classification Engine -> Knowledge Base Lookup -> Route to Tier 1 Support -> Flag for Supervisor Review

question: Which of the following paths will NOT lead to the 'Continue Tier 1 Support' node?
options: A. Assign Ticket to Agent -> Continue Tier 1 Support
B. Route to Tier 1 Support -> Ticket Handling Time > Threshold? (No)
C. Supervisor Review -> Escalate to Tier 2? (No)
D. Assign Escalation to Tier 2 Support -> Tier 2 Support Notified

question: If the 'Ticket Handling Time > Threshold?' is 'Yes', and the supervisor review leads to 'Escalate to Tier 2? (Yes)', what is the complete sequence of nodes to get back to 'Assign Escalation to Tier 2 Support'?
options: A. Flag for Supervisor Review -> Supervisor Review -> Escalate to Tier 2? -> Add details to Escalation Context -> Assign Escalation to Tier 2 Support
B. Flag for Supervisor Review -> Supervisor Review -> Escalate to Tier 2? -> Continue Tier 1 Support -> Customer Satisfied?
C. Flag for Supervisor Review -> Supervisor Review -> Escalate to Tier 2? -> Re-open Ticket - Escalate Details -> Add details to Escalation Context -> Assign Escalation to Tier 2 Support
D. Flag for Supervisor Review -> Supervisor Review -> Escalate to Tier 2? -> Add details to Escalation Context -> Tier 2 Support Notified

question: Which of the following nodes directly leads to the 'Add details to Escalation Context' node?
options: A. Re-open Ticket - Escalate Details
B. Escalate to Tier 2?
C. Supervisor Review
D. Assign Escalation to Tier 2 Support
